outcome_evidence: The oven is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot positions its gripper near the handle, making small adjustments before pulling the door outward and downward during frames 140–153 (image and left_ego_image). The door remains visibly open with the interior exposed through frame 168. The intervening slow alignment does not clearly establish a failed acquisition or sustained unproductive stall; no unintended object displacement or damage is visible.
